title: Tensorflow Recommenders (TFRS): Building a Ranking Stage

cues.en: So we talked about the retrieval stage in TFRS.
cues.zh: 前面談 TFRS 的檢索階段。

cues.en: Now let's talk about the ranking stage, which you can optionally do on top of the retrieval stage, but why not?
cues.zh: 現在談排序，可以選擇加在檢索上方，何不呢？

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So generally speaking, ranking will be using a subset of candidates that were generated by the retrieval stage.
cues.zh: 一般而言，排序使用檢索候選的子集。

cues.en: And that means that since we're dealing with a smaller amount of data, we can potentially do fancier stuff to get even better results for our final recommendations.
cues.zh: 資料較少，因此可能做更精細的事，讓最終推薦更好。

cues.en: So, for example, we could just concatenate together all of our user and movie embedding layer results and then feed that into a dense layer and then feed that again into a smaller, dense layer and finally
cues.zh: 例如，把使用者與電影的嵌入結果串接，送入 Dense，再進更小 Dense，最後，

cues.en: winnow that down to a final there with a final predicted rating for a given movie for a given user.
cues.zh: 縮減到最後一層，預測某使用者對某電影的評分。

cues.en: And noteworthy here is that we are actually going to be preserving the rating data itself in the examples that are used on the tensor flow web site.
cues.zh: 值得注意，TensorFlow 網站範例，會保留評分資料本身。

cues.en: So instead of treating this as implicit rating data, we're actually going to be feeding in the actual ratings data and trying to predict actual ratings as a result of this operation.
cues.zh: 不再當隱含資料，而是輸入實際評分，試著預測實際評分。

cues.en: So really, the idea is just that in the ranking stage we can do more complex stuff because in theory, we've winnowed down the set of candidates a little bit more.
cues.zh: 概念是，理論上候選縮減後，排序階段可以做更複雜的事。

cues.en: Now, in the example on the Google site, on Tensorflow.org, they don't actually do that.
cues.zh: 但 TensorFlow.org 的 Google 範例，沒有真的這樣做。

cues.en: They kind of start from scratch and rebuild the embedding layers and do the retrieval, and then feed those into what we are going to kind of call a ranking stage.
cues.zh: 有點從頭開始，重建嵌入層、做檢索，再送入所謂排序階段。

cues.en: But let's dive into their code and see how that works and see a little example of how a ranking stage might be implemented.
cues.zh: 深入程式，看看如何運作，以及排序可能的實作例子。

cues.en: All right, so back to TensorFlow recommenders, and we're going to go to the Recommender Basics tab here.
cues.zh: 回到 TensorFlow Recommenders，進 Recommender Basics。

cues.en: And if you do want more depth on the retrieval stage, they have a media example here that does basically the same thing we did in the previous lecture.
cues.zh: 如果想更深入檢索，這裡有更完整範例，基本上做上一堂相同事情，

cues.en: But add some more stuff to it and talks about how to deploy that to production.
cues.zh: 但加更多內容，也談如何部署正式環境。

cues.en: But we will talk about that later.
cues.zh: 稍後再談。

cues.en: Let's skip to the ranking section here.
cues.zh: 跳到 Ranking。

cues.en: So recommending movies ranking.
cues.zh: 就是 Recommending movies: ranking。

cues.en: And again, the idea here is that with the retrieval stage, we want to keep things kind of simple because it could be operating on a massive set of data.
cues.zh: 同樣，檢索可能處理巨量資料，希望保持簡單。

cues.en: But for a ranking, we're just going to use the output of that retrieval stage, which is potentially less data.
cues.zh: 排序則只用檢索輸出，資料可能較少。

cues.en: So maybe we can do something a little bit more complicated.
cues.zh: 所以，也許能做複雜一點。

cues.en: Let's click on Run in Google CoLab and get that going.
cues.zh: 按 Run in Google Colab，開始。

cues.en: And we'll start by importing those packages, which'll just take a minute or so.
cues.zh: 先匯入套件，大約一分鐘。

cues.en: So I want to kick that off straight away while we talk.
cues.zh: 先啟動，邊等邊談。

cues.en: That idea here is, that we're going to build up an embedded layer for the user IDs and an embedded layer for the movie IDs like we did before.
cues.zh: 概念是，像之前，建立使用者 ID 與電影 ID 嵌入層。

cues.en: But what's different is that we're going to concatenate those together and then feed them into a multilayer perceptron.
cues.zh: 不同的是，串接，再送入多層感知器。

cues.en: So we're going to winnow that down to a layer of neurons and then a smaller layer of neurons.
cues.zh: 濃縮到一層神經元，再更小一層。

cues.en: And finally, to a single neuron that will output a predicted rating for a given user ID movie pair.
cues.zh: 最後，單一神經元，輸出某使用者 ID／電影配對的預測評分。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: That was actually pretty quick.
cues.zh: 其實很快。

cues.en: I guess it actually cached that for me.
cues.zh: 大概替我快取了。

cues.en: So I'll go ahead and import the packages we need.
cues.zh: 匯入所需套件。

cues.en: Same as before with a few more OS level things for the example that we're using here.
cues.zh: 與之前相同，但這個範例，多一些作業系統層級的東西。

cues.en: And we'll also import tensor flow recommenders itself as TFRS. Load up our data set.
cues.zh: 也匯入 tensorflow_recommenders 為 tfrs，載入資料集。

cues.en: Note that this time we are extracting the user rating field, not just the movie titles and user IDs from the ratings data.
cues.zh: 注意，這次從評分資料，也取 user_rating，不只片名與使用者 ID。

cues.en: And that's because we're actually going to use that rating this time.
cues.zh: 因為真的要用評分。

cues.en: We're not going to just treat this as implicit data.
cues.zh: 不只是當隱含資料。

cues.en: We're going to actually try to train this Perceptron with actual ratings, one to five stars and try to predict ratings as an output.
cues.zh: 真正以一到五星的實際評分，訓練感知器，預測評分輸出。

cues.en: So let's load that up.
cues.zh: 載入。

cues.en: And we'll split that again with 80 percent of the train set and 20 percent in test.
cues.zh: 再分 80% 訓練、20% 測試。

cues.en: And we will convert the movie titles and user IDs to unique integers.
cues.zh: 把電影名稱與使用者 ID，轉唯一整數。

cues.en: We'll start by extracting the movie titles and user IDs into their own structures here and then concatenate those into a list of movie titles and user IDs that exist in our data set.
cues.zh: 先將兩者取成各自結構，再串接成資料集中存在的片名與使用者 ID 清單。

cues.en: And then we get into the model itself while that's going, that's taking a surprisingly long amount of time.
cues.zh: 等待時，進入模型本身，竟然要這麼久。

cues.en: So here we're going to start building the model itself and like we said before, the architecture here is we're going to create an embedded layer for users and embedding layer for movies.
cues.zh: 開始建立模型。如前所說，架構是使用者嵌入層與電影嵌入層。

cues.en: Then we're gonna smash those together and feed them into a multilayer Perceptron to get a final recommendation prediction, a rating prediction.
cues.zh: 再合起來，送入多層感知器，取得最後推薦預測，也就是評分預測。

cues.en: So let's set up those layers here are embedded layer for users here are which is really very similar to the query model that we set up for for the retrieval stage.
cues.zh: 設定這些層，使用者嵌入，非常像先前檢索的查詢模型。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: We just use a string lookup layer again to convert our user I.D. to unique integers and feed those in into an embedded layer this time of Dimension 32.
cues.zh: 再用 StringLookup，把使用者 ID 轉唯一整數，送入這次 32 維的嵌入層。

cues.en: So we're converting each user ID as it's trained into a 32 dimensional floating point vector.
cues.zh: 訓練時，把每位使用者 ID，轉成 32 維浮點向量。

cues.en: Same thing for movies, also getting converted into an embedded layer of 32 dimensional embedding values.
cues.zh: 電影相同，也轉成 32 維嵌入值。

cues.en: And then finally, we set up self-taught ratings, which will be the multilayer Perceptron itself that those get fed into and that we'll learn over time how to predict ratings.
cues.zh: 最後，設定 self.ratings，會是接受它們、隨時間學會預測評分的多層感知器。

cues.en: We're going to start with a 256 wide layer, feed that into a 64 y layer with a RELU activation function in between them, and finally put our final output into a single neuron that will contain our rating prediction.
cues.zh: 先 256 個單元寬的一層，再 64，之間使用 ReLU，最後單一神經元，包含評分預測。

cues.en: All right, then we put it all together in the call function here, so we take his input, our user ID and movie title lists, we create those embedding layers for the user IDs and the movie IDs, concatenate
cues.zh: 接著，在 call 裡組合：接受使用者 ID 與片名清單，建立使用者、電影嵌入，串接，

cues.en: them together and then feed that into the rating's Multilayer Perceptron. So the input to the ratings MLP is the concatenation of the user embedding layer
cues.zh: 再送入 ratings 多層感知器。因此，ratings MLP 輸入，是使用者嵌入層，

cues.en: and movie embedding layer.
cues.zh: 與電影嵌入層的串接。

cues.en: And if we're lucky, we'll get ratings out of the tail end of it.
cues.zh: 運氣好的話，尾端得到評分。

cues.en: So let's go ahead and define that model.
cues.zh: 定義模型。

cues.en: And as you can see, you can feed that model a specific user ID movie pair and this case User ID 42 and the movie ID One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest, and it should spit something out.
cues.zh: 可以看到，能輸入特定使用者 ID／電影配對，這裡使用者 42、電影 One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest，應該會輸出東西。

cues.en: In this case, the predicted rating is kind of meaningless because we haven't actually trained this thing yet, but it's giving us a value so we know what actually works.
cues.zh: 還沒訓練，預測評分沒意義，但有值，表示能運作。

cues.en: It's wired up at least with a prediction of zero point zero three seven reasonable, considering that it has no data to work with.
cues.zh: 至少連好了，預測 0.037，考慮沒有資料，很合理。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對吧？

cues.en: So it's basically predicting zero for everything at this point.
cues.zh: 此時基本上，全部預測零。

cues.en: But let's go ahead and get this thing trained.
cues.zh: 但來訓練。

cues.en: So before we can actually train it, we need to define our lost function.
cues.zh: 訓練前，需要定義損失。

cues.en: And to do that, we have this handy dandy ranking task object that's provided by TFRS. That allows us to combine both our lost function and the loss metric.
cues.zh: 使用 TFRS 提供方便的 Ranking task 物件，能結合損失函數與衡量指標。

cues.en: So we're going to see the loss function is mean squared error.
cues.zh: 損失函數是均方誤差。

cues.en: And the metric that we're going to be optimizing on is root mean squared error that we're going to be measuring as we train.
cues.zh: 訓練期間，最佳化與衡量的指標，是均方根誤差。

cues.en: Let's go ahead and set that up.
cues.zh: 設定。

cues.en: And now we put it all together, so let's go ahead and create a movie lens model class that inherits from TFRS's model class, and as we construct things here, we'll set the ranking model to that
cues.zh: 現在全部組合，建立繼承 tfrs.Model 的 MovielensModel 類別，建構時，把 ranking_model 設為

cues.en: ranking model structure that we created above.
cues.zh: 前面建立的排序模型結構。

cues.en: The task, again, is defined, as we just described, taking in the mean squared error, lost function and a root mean squared error metric.
cues.zh: Task 再次如剛才定義，接受均方誤差損失，以及均方根誤差指標。

cues.en: We then create the compute loss function here, which just calls the ranking model for the given user IDs and movie titles that we're feeding in as we're training and compute the loss and the metrics given
cues.zh: 接著建立 compute_loss，對訓練時傳入的使用者 ID 與片名，呼叫排序模型，再根據

cues.en: that task that we just define so pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 剛定義的 task，計算損失與指標，很直接。

cues.en: Go ahead and run that and we'll go ahead and compile the model.
cues.zh: 執行，接著編譯模型。

cues.en: So we instantiate it, and tell it that we're going to use the adagrad gradient descent variant with a hyper parameter learning rate of point one.
cues.zh: 實例化，指定使用 Adagrad 梯度下降變形，學習率超參數 0.1。

cues.en: That's something you could obviously experiment with.
cues.zh: 顯然，可以實驗。

cues.en: And finally, we will shuffle back and cache the training and evaluation data and train it over three epochs.
cues.zh: 最後，打亂、分批、快取訓練與評估資料，訓練三個週期。

cues.en: And this should go pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 應該很快。

cues.en: All right, you can see that error metric getting smaller and smaller and yeah, even after three epochs, we're kind of hitting diminishing returns, right.
cues.zh: 可以看到，誤差越來越小，甚至才三個週期，就開始報酬遞減，對吧？

cues.en: So that converged pretty quickly.
cues.zh: 很快收斂。

cues.en: Now we can evaluate the model on our test data that we cast above here.
cues.zh: 現在，能對前面快取的測試資料，評估模型。

cues.en: And see what we get.
cues.zh: 看看結果。

cues.en: All right, looks like it worked.
cues.zh: 好，看來有效。

cues.en: So the total RMSE was one point one one, you know, that's not too bad for a rating.
cues.zh: 總 RMSE 是 1.11，對評分來說不算差。

cues.en: Value could could be better, obviously.
cues.zh: 當然，還能更好。

cues.en: And we'll talk about ways of expanding this model next and fancier things you can do with TFRS.
cues.zh: 下一堂，談擴充模型，以及 TFRS 更精細的做法。

cues.en: But for now, that's an example of a ranking model in action where we're doing something more complicated in this case, combining two embedding layers and feeding that into a multi layer
cues.zh: 目前，這就是排序模型實例，做比較複雜的事：結合兩個嵌入層，送入多層

cues.en: Perceptron. And you can see that we did all that with really a minimal amount of code.
cues.zh: 感知器。程式碼真的很少。

cues.en: So that's the power of TFRS.
cues.zh: 這就是 TFRS 的力量。
